node.title: L1 quotient-chart bounded core-boundary closure
node.statement: At the L1 cutoff ell>=c_0 n/log_2 n with ell>2P_0, one genuine quotient/coset source chart has only M+N<=log_2(n)/c_0 total petal and core fibers. Dense/sparse orientation plus at most P_0 exceptional petal points counts all p<=P_0 supports; the quotient-boundary router counts every beta<=B_0 defect locator by at most 2^N(B_0+1)n^B_0; and the strict-window plus thin-edge CRT theorems contribute at most q^(2P_0) numerators throughout every degree strip. Hence the complete common-pencil box is at most (P_0+1)(B_0+1)n^(1/c_0+P_0+B_0+2 gamma P_0) per source chart when q<=n^gamma. Cross-chart aggregation, unbounded boundary, non-quotient cores, and arbitrary petal locators remain open.
